overall: Statute, Justia, LII, Register and docket rows hold up. Their generalised citations reached body text via the script or WebFetch, so the azleg pattern is confirmed by one script request per row despite the 120 s crawl delay. WebFetch is gated for every constructed azleg, azcourts and Westlaw URL, so several 'untested' statuses should read 'gated'. The research run's /azrules/ request locked www.azcourts.gov out of the script for the day, so the Supreme Court OpinionFiles row and the rule-amendments index could not be reproduced. appeals2 is unreachable. The A.A.C. chapter pattern is still unproven on a live chapter. Justia needs the published Court of Appeals slugs, and the regexes miss 'art. IV, pt. 2' and family-law rules.
